parts.label: (a)
parts.note: Both give x < 2. Verified: 5 - 3x + 6 > 2x + 1 gives 10 > 5x, so x < 2.

parts.label: (b)
parts.note: Both give 6q^4/p. Verified: (9p^4 q^-2)^(1/2) = 3p^2 q^-1; times 2p^-3 q^5 = 6p^-1 q^4.

parts.label: (c)
parts.note: Both give t = k/(v^2 + 3). Verified: v^2 t = k - 3t, t(v^2 + 3) = k.

parts.label: (d)
parts.note: Both give x = 3.71 or x = -1.21. Verified: 7x + 5 = 2x^2 + 2x - 4 gives 2x^2 - 5x - 9 = 0, discriminant 97, x = (5 +/- 9.8489)/4 = 3.712 or -1.212; neither root is an excluded value (1 or -2).
